speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with possible Urinary Retention and Bowel Ileus.

The history of prolonged labor, high fever, uterine tenderness, and decreased bowel sounds is highly concerning for uterine infection; I need to know if you have had difficulty passing urine or if you have had any bowel movements in the last 24 hours to assess for urinary retention or ileus.

REQUEST TEST: Urine output measurement and Rectal exam for stool presence
REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic Ultrasound
